note: Everything sells AT MRP -- that is how the shop prices, so `price` equals `mrp` on every row and no per-product discount is shown. The only discount is a coupon code, which is in shop.json. Prices are realistic 2026 Mumbai MRPs but ILLUSTRATIVE, not scraped; correct them with tools/pricelist.pl and tools/setprice.pl. Both are whole rupees: there is no floating point anywhere in this app.
